harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-26, before any result (Rule 22, #758). The battery on the new track-p head bbe83d0b - and the first zoo runs on a YAML-only configuration: the shipped settings live in harness/pborg.yaml (6daa73f5...), the adapter (#813) applies the profile's settings to the template through the pinned pborg-settings.py, and no borg.txt exists. Full-game pilot on the current head: one game per class to death or the 1,000,000-turn cap. PRIMARY: CL20 reached; reported per game: max CL, max DL, outcome/death cause and turn, town vs dungeon turns. Gate: no config_error; one binary; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; the staged pborg.yaml hash recorded per cell (pborg_yaml_sha256) and verified at any death replay. Progress endpoint CL5 reached by 100,000 turns - known attainment out of all starts, deaths, unfinished and alive at the cutoff with CL5 reported separately; DL3/DL5 and median first-turn-at-level-5 as diagnostics. Descriptive (RULES 14).
